subject: CAIQ control orchestration: telemetry proof, sampling window & runbook
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ control orchestration: telemetry proof, sampling window & runbook

Team —

Solstice Capital has a narrow CAIQ follow-up asking for specific telemetry proofs for a subset of controls (mainly CCM_TEL-1, CCM_TEL-3, CCM_INF-2). Id like to set a short sprint to gather: the mapping spreadsheet (control -> artifact), a sampling window for logs (they requested examples), and a lightweight runbook we can share during their review call.

Can each of you own one lane: Marissa, can you take the control->artifact mapping and owner attestation column? Ben, can you put together the sample log extracts and a short note on how the logs were collected (sampling window + environment)? I added a starter sheet in Drive (link below) and a CAIQ tab with the three control IDs pre-filled.

Targets: first draft by end of day tomorrow (2026-05-10 17:00 PDT). Attachments: I uploaded a template mapping workbook (20260509-caiq-telemetry-mapping.xlsx).

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xYzExampleDriveLink

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: 20260509-caiq-telemetry-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@solsticecap.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Solstice Security Team <audits@solsticecap.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T14:08:22-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control orchestration: telemetry proof, sampling window & runbook

Thanks Rishi — and hi Marissa/Ben. Quick clarifications from our side so you can prioritize:

- For CCM_TEL-1 (telemetry collection) we need a one-page narrative + two sample log extracts showing event IDs and timestamps tied to a short query.
- For CCM_TEL-3 wedd like an explanation of your retention policy and a sample of the retention-job run log (if available).
- For CCM_INF-2 (inference isolation) please include a mapping that shows which telemetry spans are per-tenant vs. aggregated. A short diagram is OK here.

Sampling window: a 72-hour window is fine; if you can provide a second, smaller window (24h) that demonstrates a different traffic profile, that helps.

We will treat all files as privileged. If anything is sensitive, mark it and we can redact on our side; just flag in the mapping workbook. Also we'll need contact info for a subject-matter expert to join a 30-minute walkthrough (day after you share artifacts).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — well aim to provide feedback within 48 hours of receiving artifacts.

Regards,
Sarah Kim
Security Assessment Lead — Solstice Capital

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@solsticecap.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:45:12-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control orchestration: telemetry proof, sampling window & runbook

Sarah — thanks for the clarifications. Quick status:

- Control->artifact mapping: completed for CCM_TEL-1 and CCM_INF-2; CCM_TEL-3 retention-job log requires ops assist (Ben to attach). See tab "mapping_v1" in the Drive sheet. I marked anything PII-sensitive in the comments.
- Narrative: I drafted a one-page narrative for CCM_TEL-1 and CCM_TEL-3 (attached as a notes sheet in the workbook).
- Diagram: added a simple tenant/aggregation diagram (Exported as PNG within the workbook comments).

Attachments included in this message: redwood-sample-logs-202605.tar.gz (attachment-stub) — this contains two small gziped extracts from the 2026-04-28 00:00 to 2026-04-30 23:59 window (72h) and a second 24h window (2026-04-15 12:00 to 2026-04-16 12:00). Each extract has a readme.txt with the query used. I flagged the session ids that are tenant-specific.

Doc links: mapping workbook updated here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xYzExampleDriveLink

Next steps: Ben, can you confirm the retention-job log snippet and add a line about how retention runs are scheduled (cron + job id)? Also, we should nominate the SME for the walkthrough — I propose Ben (telemetry lead) and I can join as backup.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sample-logs-202605.tar.gz (attachment-stub), mapping workbook (drive link)
